rationale: Single trade-press article on Adriatic Bank Apple Pay; good vendor evidence but the deep URL is a one-off artifact, not a feed.
Commercial ME tender aggregator with alerts and award archive; high-value vendor-win funnel but subscription-gated and URL unverified.
eKapija tender bulletin covers private-company tenders and awards for ME; paid B2B service requiring registration.
Regional Balkan+EU aggregator with IT/telecom taxonomy useful for group-level competitions; likely registration/paywall.
OTP group supplier portal is the sourcing gateway for CKB Montenegro, the largest ME bank; public and durable.
Erste Group Procurement governs all Erste Podgorica external spend; public supplier document set and process.
EGP's dedicated supplier site is a recorded lead not yet fetched; confirm content and overlap with the erstegroup.com page.
Erste Serbia procurement page shows the group's regional vendor-registration and tender categories; public template for the ME entity.
Erste Bank Podgorica press stream is where local vendor go-lives and tech partnerships surface; monitor the site root.
NLB Banka Podgorica corporate site; plausible host of local javni poziv and partnership announcements for a top-tier ME buyer.
CKB is the largest ME bank and issues javni poziv/oglasi locally; site root is the monitoring anchor despite a failed fetch.
Bankar.me republishes ME bank notices verbatim; cheapest continuous sweep for bank-issued calls and vendor news.
Open local-language javni poziv aggregator catching bank calls that never reach CeJN; low credibility but free and durable.
CBCG tenders/oglasi page: authoritative central-bank buyer of payment and IT infrastructure, explicitly allowed.
CeJN state e-procurement portal is the baseline award record for banking-IT vendors in Montenegro; public and allowed.
Procurement policy directorate defines obligated buyers and points to appeal decisions; mine once for framework, not a signal feed.
Chamber of Economy NATO-tender registry is a one-off lead list of pre-qualified local IT firms for the actor map.
ECEPP carries EBRD-financed ME financial-sector contracts naming suppliers; a distinct route bypassing state and bank sites.
SAP Business Network Discovery may expose OTP/CKB sourcing events but requires supplier registration to see postings.
Low-credibility commercial ME tender database; redundant with CeJN and nabavke.com unless private-tender coverage is proven.
Generic global aggregator page for Montenegro; redundancy layer only, paywalled and low credibility.
Claims private-tender and EBRD coverage for ME, which is the specific gap here, but alerts are members-only — verify before buying.
Lowest-credibility global aggregator, unverified URL, fully redundant with the other tender sources in this batch.
Addiko ME is a digital-first buyer of card and channel technology; site is the only local publication point for its calls.
CBCG bank register is the authoritative roster of domestic ME banks — mine once as the crawl seed for the buyer actor map.
nabavke.com mirrors CeJN award PDFs at stable fetchable paths, the practical workaround for the CeJN SPA and the richest vendor-name source.
English-locale duplicate of the CBCG tenderi-i-oglasi page already covered by c_203 on the same domain.
